entities.name: Autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease
observations: PKD1-associated ADPKD is a progressive cyst-forming disorder; a neonatal ultrasound may be normal before cysts become sonographically apparent.

entities.name: Normal neonatal renal ultrasound
observations: In an otherwise typical PKD1 mutation carrier, kidneys are most likely normal on ultrasound shortly after birth because renal cysts may not yet be visible; rare severe early-onset disease can differ.
